name: Substrate Dev
description: How we ship Substrate. Product ideas are shaped + human-approved on the separate **Roadmap** board; an agent copies each approved feature into **Ready to Start** here (small technical/internal improvements can be created in Ready to Start directly). Work then moves **Ready to Start → Spec & Plan → Build & Test → Review → Pending Review and Approval → Merged.** **All feature work merges to the `dev` branch — never straight to `main`.** `main` only advances on a release (dev → main + a version tag), tracked on the separate **Release** board. Three gates: Spec→Build needs `plan_approved` (Diego approves the technical plan), Build→Review needs `tests_green`, Review→Pending needs `reviews_approved` (both independent reviewers APPROVE). The final Pending→Merged gate is a **human-only** sign-off (dogfoods B3): an agent cannot set `diego_approved` — Diego clears it with `substrate approve <task_id> diego_approved`, then the PR merges to `dev`.

groups.name: Ready to Start
groups.description: Approved and ready for technical work. Product features arrive here copied from the Roadmap board's Roadmap-Ready column (already human-approved); small technical/internal improvements can be created here directly. Move an item to Spec & Plan to begin. (Group id stays `ideas` as a stable key — the display name is what changed.)

groups.name: Spec & Plan
groups.description: Writing the spec + plan as self-contained HTML docs in `docs/specs/<slug>.html` and `docs/plans/<slug>.html` (linked from `spec_doc`). Needs Diego approval (`plan_approved`) before Build.

groups.name: Pending Review and Approval
groups.description: PR open against `dev`, automated reviews passed — awaiting Diego's own review + approval.

groups.name: Merged to dev
groups.description: Approved + merged to the `dev` branch. (Releasing `dev` → `main` is a separate flow on the Release board.)

policies.name: Build must be green before Review
policies.description: Local build + tsc + lint + format + all tests pass before a change goes to Review.

definition.on_failure_message: Set tests_green=true only after build + tsc + lint + format + all tests pass locally (CI is billing-blocked).

policies.name: Reviews must pass before Diego
policies.description: Both independent reviewers must APPROVE (re-run any that died; re-review fix rounds) before a change reaches Diego.

definition.on_failure_message: Set reviews_approved=true only once BOTH independent reviewers have APPROVED (never self-grade; re-run dead reviewers).

policies.name: Diego signs off before Merge
policies.description: The human-only merge gate (B3). An agent cannot set diego_approved; Diego runs `substrate approve <task_id> diego_approved`.

definition.on_failure_message: Diego must approve before the PR merges to the `dev` branch — run `substrate approve <task_id> diego_approved`. An agent cannot set this field. (Never merge feature work to `main`; `main` moves only on a release — see the Release board.)

policies.name: Two-reviewer gate protocol
policies.description: Reminds the agent how the Review gate works whenever a task is in Review.

definition.message: Spawn >=2 independent adversarial reviewers with distinct lenses; wait for BOTH to finish; re-run any that die; fold in every blocking finding and re-review the fix round. Both must APPROVE before you set reviews_approved. Never self-grade a review.

policies.name: Intake: copy approved roadmap features here
policies.description: Fires while a task is in Ready to Start — where items come from and where they go next.

definition.message: Ready to Start holds work that's approved to build. Two intake paths: (1) PRODUCT features — check the Roadmap board's Roadmap-Ready column for human-approved plans and copy each one here (create a task carrying the product plan; reference the roadmap task's id for lineage); (2) small technical/internal improvements may be created here directly. To begin work, move an item to Spec & Plan and author its technical spec + plan — which then needs Diego's `plan_approved` before Build.

policies.name: Spec & plan need approval before Build
policies.description: Human gate: the spec + plan must be approved by Diego before implementation starts.

definition.on_failure_message: The spec + plan need Diego's approval before Build — run `substrate approve <task_id> plan_approved`. An agent cannot set this field. (Make sure the spec + plan HTML docs exist under docs/specs/ and docs/plans/ and are linked from spec_doc first.)

policies.name: Spec & plan authoring convention
policies.description: Fires while a task is in Spec & Plan — where the docs go and what they must contain.

definition.message: Author the spec + plan as self-contained HTML documents (openable in a browser): the SPEC at `docs/specs/<slug>.html` and the PLAN at `docs/plans/<slug>.html`, and link both from the task's `spec_doc` field. Spec = problem, goals/non-goals, scope, acceptance criteria; Plan = approach, step-by-step work, risks, test strategy. The spec + plan then need Diego's approval (`plan_approved`) before Build — an agent cannot self-approve.
